bibl.title: The Provenance and Cultic Context of an Egyptian Bronze Flute in the British Museum (EA 12742).
bibl.seg: Eddy Lanciers, The Provenance and Cultic Context of an Egyptian Bronze Flute in the British Museum (EA 12742).
bibl.note: British Museum Inv. EA 12742: bronze flute with an incised demotic inscription [ed.: A.F. Shore, A Bronze Flute with Demotic Inscription, British Museum Quarterly 30 (1965) pp. 35-36; = Short Texts I, 26]. - Onomastic data prove that this cult instrument, which was written in the Ptolemaic or at the latest early Roman period, comes from the Theban area.
